versions.changelog: Plays a DVD's own menus in a browser: a Disc menu link on series and movies that have a menu pack, and a player page that signs in as the viewer and plays the episodes or film the menus start, with the audio and subtitles chosen in the menus.
First release: an empty plugin that installs from the Catalog

name: Disc Menu
description: Plays the title screen and menus extracted from a DVD or Blu-ray, next to the episodes they start.
overview: Play a disc's own title screen and menus in Jellyfin
